name: nawa-ui
description: Nawa UI — accessible, themeable UI components for React, Vue, Svelte, Astro and React Native

scripts.docs:build: npm run build -w @nawa-ui/core && npm run build -w @nawa-ui/react && npm run build -w @nawa-ui/docs
scripts.release:check: npm run build -w @nawa-ui/core && npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @nawa-ui/react -w @nawa-ui/vue -w @nawa-ui/three
